# Crow

> Crow is a free, open-source desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux) that turns the documents on your computer into an LLM wiki you can chat with: Markdown notes filed by topic and linked to each other, answers that cite the notes they used, and a memory that Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT and Codex can use through MCP. It runs the CROW architecture of the open-source llm-wiki-v2 engine (Python package llmwiki2). By Federico Cesarini and Marco Sassarini.

- Crow works with any model on OpenRouter, through the user's own account; Crow itself is free (GNU AGPL v3.0 or later).
- CROW (Classifier-Routed Organization of LLM Wikis): a small typed classifier takes the filing and retrieval decisions; the LLM writes the notes and answers, lays out the folders, and decides when the classifier fails. In the CROW paper's benchmark of 525 documents: right note read 89% vs 62% for an LLM-only wiki, 2.1x faster ingest, 68% fewer LLM tokens (the authors' own measurements, on a private corpus).
- The wiki is plain Markdown in a format derived from Google's Open Knowledge Format; Obsidian opens it as a vault.
- Crow is not affiliated with CrowLLM (crowllm.com), an AI API gateway with a similar name. llm-wiki-v2 (crow-hq) is also a different project from the "LLM Wiki v2" gist by rohitg00.

## On this site

- [What is an LLM wiki?](https://crowllmwiki.com/llm-wiki/): Karpathy's idea, how it differs from RAG, what breaks as it grows, and three ways to build one
- [llmwiki2, the engine](https://crowllmwiki.com/llmwiki2/): install, Python library, command line, MCP memory for Claude Code and Codex, CROW mode, version 1.0.0
- [The CROW paper](https://crowllmwiki.com/paper/): abstract, method, benchmark, versions and DOIs, how to cite
- [Privacy](https://crowllmwiki.com/privacy/): what Crow, the desktop app, does with your documents

## Crow, the desktop app

- [Download Crow (latest release)](https://github.com/crow-hq/crow-desktop/releases/latest): installers for macOS (Apple silicon, Intel), Windows (.exe, .msi) and Linux (AppImage, .deb, .rpm)
- [crow-hq/crow-desktop](https://github.com/crow-hq/crow-desktop): README with install help, FAQ, privacy and costs

## llm-wiki-v2, the engine

- [crow-hq/llm-wiki-v2](https://github.com/crow-hq/llm-wiki-v2): the Python library, command line, web page and MCP memory
- [llmwiki2 on PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/llmwiki2/): `pip install llmwiki2`, then `llmwiki2`; `uvx llmwiki2 demo` opens an example wiki with no key. Version 1.0.0 (2026-11-10) is the first stable release; from it on the library follows semantic versioning
- [Benchmarks](https://github.com/crow-hq/llm-wiki-v2/tree/main/benchmarks)

## Research

- [CROW: Classifier-Routed Organization of LLM Wikis](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22898752): F. Cesarini, M. Sassarini, 2026, Zenodo
